subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - clarifying questions
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Sunrise Health

Hi Alex / Procurement team,

Great to meet you on the call today - thanks for the time. As discussed, we're starting the vendor security questionnaire so your security and procurement teams can evaluate Redwood for the pilot. Attached is our SIG/standard questionnaire template to speed things up (redwood-sig-template.xlsx).

A few clarifying questions up front so we can route items efficiently:
- SOC 2: Do you require a current SOC 2 Type II report? If yes, do you need reports from the last 12 months or a specific period?
- HIPAA/GDPR: Is Sunrise Health operating as a HIPAA-covered entity or business associate, and are there GDPR/data residency constraints we should be aware of?
- Hosting / Data residency: Are there any restrictions on where inference or data at rest can be hosted (US-only, region-specific)?
- Subprocessors: Any specific vendor exclusions or disclosure needs for third-party subprocessors?
- Data use / model training: Can you confirm whether you require contractual language that prohibits use of customer data for model training?
- Timeline & owner: What timeline are you targeting to complete the SIG? Please confirm the primary security contact for follow-ups (name, email).

Next steps we propose:
1) We attach our SIG template to this thread.
2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough with our security lead to go over any high-risk questions.
3) Please return the completed questionnaire or call out any items you want offlined.

I'll loop Dylan (security lead) to help with technical questions, and Marissa (CSM) will coordinate procurement/commercial items.

Thanks - looking forward to your responses.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood-sig-template.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@sunrisehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Sunrise Health

Hi Camila,

Thanks - good recap and appreciate the template. A few quick answers and notes from our side:
- SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II. Our procurement checklist asks for the most recent 12-month period report (or in-progress timeline if not yet available). We're okay accepting a pending report if you can provide an expected completion date and milestones.
- HIPAA/GDPR: Sunrise is a HIPAA-covered entity; HIPAA controls are mandatory. GDPR applies for a small subset of our EU patient data - we can flag which datasets are in scope later.
- Hosting: Primary requirement is US-only for PHI. Non-PHI can reside in US/EU.
- Subprocessors: We have standard exclusions for certain vendors (list to follow from procurement). Please provide your subprocessors list and subprocessor agreement language.
- Model training: We need a contractual clause that explicitly prohibits using our PHI for model training. Non-PHI usage requires explicit opt-in.

Attached is our security overview and a short vendor intake PDF (sunrise-ssc-overview.pdf) - it includes our timeline expectations. Procurement will send the formal SOW/contract checklist once we clear security.

We'd like to do the 30-min walkthrough - can your security lead do Thursday morning PT? If not, next week works.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Sunrise Health
alex.johnson@sunrisehealth.com
(202) 555-0124

Alex / procurement team - thanks for the quick responses and the overview doc. A few clarifications from our side and proposed next steps:

Clarifications:
- SOC 2: Redwood currently maintains SOC 2 Type II in-progress with an expected completion date in Q3 2027. We can provide the formal report once issued and a bridge letter in the interim. I'll confirm exact dates with our compliance team and share (Dylan will follow up).
- HIPAA: We understand Sunrise is a covered entity. Redwood supports HIPAA workloads via our Private deployment and dedicated offering; we will surface the required BAAs and technical controls.
- Hosting / Data residency: We can commit to US-only hosting for PHI. For non-PHI, EU hosting is available. We'll include region-specific deployment options in the questionnaire responses.
- Subprocessors & training: We'll attach our current subprocessors list and standard subprocessors addendum. Redwood does not train models on customer data by default - we can include a contractual prohibition for PHI and an opt-in flow for any non-PHI training uses.

Proposed next steps / owners:
1) Dylan (cc'd) will own the technical/security answers and will populate the SIG template with our standard responses.
2) Marissa (cc'd) will pick up procurement/commercial items and the BAA.
3) Please send any procurement-specific checklist items to Marissa so she can coordinate.
4) Let's schedule a 30-min walkthrough to go over high-risk items. Proposed time: Thu, May 28 at 10:00 AM PT - please confirm if that works.

I've uploaded our draft responses and subprocessors list to this Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSIG and attached the two files referenced earlier. If you have any particularly high-risk questions we should prioritize, flag them here and Dylan will prep answers.

Thanks again - we'll aim to get a draft of the SIG back within 3 business days after the walkthrough.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference
